content.text:
Not safe by default, but the docs give you a fix: use the `prefix()` option.

- Import Tailwind with `@import "tailwindcss" prefix(tw);`. Keep writing `@theme` variables unprefixed, such as `--color-avocado-100`. The generated CSS variables then get the prefix, for example `--tw-color-avocado-100`, "to avoid conflicts with any existing variables in your project" (`src/docs/upgrade-guide.mdx`, "Using a prefix").
- This also keeps built-in utilities like `rounded-lg` working. Your variables are prefixed in the output, so you don't have to strip the built-in ones.
- A side effect is that utility class names change too. The prefix is now a variant-style start of the class, like `tw:flex` (same section).
- I couldn't run the graphify query because Bash was denied. `theme.mdx` has no mention of prefixes, so I used only the upgrade guide.
